name: gian-remote
description: Gian Remote Server and Web client

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @gian/shared build && pnpm --filter @gian/chat-ui build && pnpm --filter @gian/remote-server build && pnpm --filter @gian/remote-web build
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @gian/remote-server test && pnpm --filter @gian/chat-ui test && pnpm --filter @gian/remote-web test
